wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap convent footprint and separately mapped chapels and granary establish the occupied site. Court and path positions use the mapped named features.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the low tiled convent, rocks and separate chapels. Near views add the cork-like doorway frames, small fountain and chimney vents.
limitations: Roof subdivisions, retaining stone sizes, doors and hermitage heights are approximate. The exterior layout follows the named mapped buildings.
Cloister furnishing positions, granite boulders and the main entry steps are reconstructed from oblique photographs and the terrain. The small rooms are modeled from their visible exterior.
